verdict.rationale: Shopify documents agent attribution fields on carts (referring_domain, click IDs, UTM parameters), and checkouts inherit that attribution metadata. Shopify also scopes orders as 'placed through your agent', which implies it records the originating agent. No evidence shows a merchant-facing way to report on or filter transactions by agent; missing for 10: merchant-side reporting or analytics by agent, filtering orders by agent in admin, confirmation that attribution persists onto the final order record, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, orders are attributed to the originating agent and I can report on or filter transactions by agent

citations.quote: the server loads the referenced cart and inherits its `line_items`, `context`, `buyer`, and associated attribution metadata
whenever an order placed through your agent has a committed change
